case: Kitara Group (fictional bank and insurer, Kampala, with Kitara Kenya in Nairobi)

rule_hints.phone_valid_after_cleaning: digits only, 9 digits after 256, starts with 7
rule_hints.impossible_date_rule: date_of_birth between 1900-01-01 and 2026-10-29; opened_date not after 2026-10-29
rule_hints.duplicate_rule: same national_id (when present), or same lower-case name with the same date_of_birth, different customer_id

branch_reports.layout: title merged over six columns; header on row 4; sub-total row inside the data; formulas; a note under the table
months across the columns; merged group headers over three columns each; header on row 6; branch code in lower case
two sheets; amounts stored as text with the UGX prefix; three date formats in one column
metrics down the rows with units in column B; blank rows and section headings; a footnote in the cells
different header names for the same measures; N/A and dash in numeric cells; a cell comment; formulas that return blank
Kenya shillings; a hidden column; header on row 3; unsigned check line

scans.tool: tesseract via pytesseract at 150 dpi, English

per_scan.file: scans/Scan Customer Complaint Letter by Post.pdf

scans.note: Character error rate = edit distance between OCR text and the known source text, after collapsing white space, divided by source length. Another Tesseract version can give slightly different values.

method.text_source: pypdf for text PDFs, python-docx for .docx, plain read for .txt, Tesseract OCR for scans
method.bm25: k1 1.5, b 0.75, lowercase tokens, short stopword list, chunks with no matching word are not returned
method.meaning: stand-in: TF-IDF on word unigrams and character 4-grams, SVD to 64 dimensions, cosine similarity
method.hybrid: reciprocal rank fusion, k 60, top 50 of each list
method.hit_rule: a question is a hit at k when any of the top k chunks comes from the gold document (doc_id)

per_question.question: How many days of annual leave am I entitled to each year?
How long is the probation period for a new permanent employee?
How many days a week may staff work remotely?

What are the Saturday opening hours of the branches?

paraphrase.definition: question shares at most one word (after lowercasing and removing stopwords) with the passage that holds the answer

swahili.note: Three questions are about Swahili circulars and every method finds them. Three are Swahili questions about English documents: keyword search finds 0 of them and the stand-in meaning search finds 0.

search_evaluation.note: Rank 0 means the gold document is not in the top 10 chunks.
